key.name: position-in-panel
key.summary: Position in the panel
key.description: Where in the panel the monitors should be positioned.

key.name: monitor-order
key.summary: Order of the monitors in the panel
key.description: The order in which the monitors are shown in the panel, from first to last. Valid entries are cpu, mem, disk, net, gpu, and npu.

key.name: cpu-display
key.summary: How to visualize the CPU monitor
key.description: How to visualize the CPU monitor

key.name: mem-display
key.summary: How to visualize the memory monitor
key.description: How to visualize the memory monitor

key.name: fs-display
key.summary: How to visualize the filesystem monitor
key.description: How to visualize the filesystem monitor

key.name: show-icons
key.summary: Show icons beside monitors
key.description: Display icons next to each monitor to help identify them.

key.name: show-menu-actions
key.summary: Show action buttons in menus
key.description: Display action buttons for launching the system monitor, etc.

key.name: show-cpu
key.summary: Show the CPU monitor
key.description: Show the CPU monitor.

key.name: cpu-show-value
key.summary: Show CPU usage value in the panel
key.description: Display the CPU usage value next to the CPU monitor.

key.name: show-mem
key.summary: Show the memory monitor
key.description: Show the memory monitor.

key.name: mem-show-value
key.summary: Show memory usage value in the panel
key.description: Display the memory usage value next to the memory monitor.

key.name: show-net
key.summary: Show the network monitor
key.description: Show the network monitor.

key.name: net-show-bars
key.summary: Show network speeds as stacked bars
key.description: When enabled, show upload and download speeds as horizontal bars stacked in the panel.

key.name: net-show-values
key.summary: Show network speeds in the panel
key.description: Display upload and download speeds next to the network monitor.

key.name: net-max-speed
key.summary: Maximum network speed for stacked bars
key.description: The network speed in megabits per second that fills the stacked bars completely.

key.name: show-disk
key.summary: Show the disk activity monitor
key.description: Show the disk monitor.

key.name: disk-show-values
key.summary: Show disk read and write speeds in the panel
key.description: Display disk read and write speeds next to the disk monitor.

key.name: show-gpu
key.summary: Show GPU monitors
key.description: Show a monitor for each detected GPU.

key.name: gpu-show-value
key.summary: Show GPU usage value in the panel
key.description: Display GPU usage values next to the GPU monitors.

key.name: show-npu
key.summary: Show NPU monitors
key.description: Show a monitor for each detected NPU.

key.name: npu-show-value
key.summary: Show NPU usage value in the panel
key.description: Display NPU usage values next to the NPU monitors.

key.name: show-fs
key.summary: Show the filesystem monitor
key.description: Show the filesystem monitor.

key.name: fs-show-value
key.summary: Show filesystem usage value in the panel
key.description: Display the filesystem usage value next to the filesystem monitor.

key.name: group-procs
key.summary: Group processes with the same command
key.description: Aggregate the usage metrics for all processes by their name.

key.name: use-system-accent
key.summary: Use the system accent color
key.description: Use the system accent color (GNOME 47+).

key.name: meter-fg-color
key.summary: Color of the meter bars and chart areas
key.description: The color of meter bars and chart areas, in either hex or RGBA format.

key.name: round-meter-bars
key.summary: Round meter bars
key.description: Round the corners of the meter track and its filled bars.

key.name: refresh-rate
key.summary: How frequently TopHat will check system resource usage
key.description: Refresh intervals are 5, 2.5, 1.25, 0.625, and 0.3125 seconds for slow, medium, fast, faster, and fastest, respectively. Faster updates may increase system resource usage.

key.name: monitor-app
key.summary: Application opened by the monitor action button
key.description: Choose whether monitor action buttons open GNOME System Monitor or Resources.

key.name: cpu-line-chart
key.summary: Show the CPU meter as a line chart
key.description: When true, the CPU panel meter connects the per-core (or total) usage values with a line and fills the area beneath it, instead of drawing bars.

key.name: cpu-line-separators
key.summary: Show separators between cores in the CPU line chart
key.description: When true, draw vertical separators between cores in the CPU line chart.

key.name: cpu-line-soft-fill
key.summary: Use a softer fill in the CPU line chart
key.description: When true, render the CPU line chart's filled area with reduced opacity while keeping its outline fully opaque.

key.name: cpu-history-area
key.summary: Show CPU history as an area chart
key.description: When true, show the detailed CPU history as a continuous filled area instead of bars.

key.name: cpu-history-soft-fill
key.summary: Use a softer fill in the CPU history chart
key.description: When true, render the CPU history area with reduced opacity while keeping its outline fully opaque.

key.name: gpu-history-area
key.summary: Show GPU history as an area chart
key.description: When true, show detailed GPU utilization history as a continuous filled area instead of bars.

key.name: gpu-history-soft-fill
key.summary: Use a softer fill in the GPU history chart
key.description: When true, render the GPU history area with reduced opacity while keeping its outline fully opaque.

key.name: npu-history-area
key.summary: Show NPU history as an area chart
key.description: When true, show detailed NPU utilization history as a continuous filled area instead of bars.

key.name: npu-history-soft-fill
key.summary: Use a softer fill in the NPU history chart
key.description: When true, render the NPU history area with reduced opacity while keeping its outline fully opaque.

key.name: cpu-show-cores
key.summary: Show a meter bar for each CPU core
key.description: When true, the CPU monitors will show a meter bar representing each CPU core. When false, one bar will represent all CPU usage.

key.name: cpu-sort-cores
key.summary: Sort CPU meter bars by usage
key.description: When true, the CPU monitors will be sorted by usage.

key.name: cpu-normalize-proc-use
key.summary: Divide process CPU usage by CPU core count
key.description: CPU usage is computed so that full usage of one core yields 100%; full usage of multiple cores results in numbers greater than 100%. If this setting is enabled, divide that usage by core count, to ensure it's less than 100%.

key.name: mem-abs-units
key.summary: Display memory usage in absolute units
key.description: Display memory usage in absolute units in the top bar, instead of as a percentage.

key.name: mem-history-area
key.summary: Show memory history as an area chart
key.description: When true, show detailed memory history as a continuous filled area instead of bars.

key.name: mem-history-soft-fill
key.summary: Use a softer fill in the memory history chart
key.description: When true, render the memory history area with reduced opacity while keeping its outline fully opaque.

key.name: net-history-area
key.summary: Show network history as area charts
key.description: When true, show detailed network history as continuous filled areas instead of bars.

key.name: net-history-soft-fill
key.summary: Use a softer fill in the network history chart
key.description: When true, render network history areas with reduced opacity while keeping their outlines fully opaque.

key.name: network-device
key.summary: Network device to monitor
key.description: Network device to monitor.

key.name: network-usage-unit
key.summary: Unit for showing network usage
key.description: Show network usage in bytes or bits.

key.name: mount-to-monitor
key.summary: The mount to monitor in the top bar
key.description: The disk usage monitor will show the filesystem usage for this partition in the top bar.

key.name: fs-hide-in-menu
key.summary: List of mount points to hide in the disk activity menu
key.description: List of mount points to hide in the disk activity menu.

key.name: disk-history-area
key.summary: Show disk activity history as area charts
key.description: When true, show detailed disk activity history as continuous filled areas instead of bars.

key.name: disk-history-soft-fill
key.summary: Use a softer fill in the disk history charts
key.description: When true, render disk history areas with reduced opacity while keeping their outlines fully opaque.
